annotations.title: 入札予定（発注の見通し）を探す

description: Use this when the user asks what public works, services or goods Japanese buyers plan to put out to tender in the coming months (発注の見通し), before the tender notice is published. Returns up to 10 planned procurements, soonest period first, with the total count and counts per quarter. Periods are as published by the buyer (Japanese fiscal year starts in April). For tenders already open, use search_bid_notices. 入札予定・発注の見通し・発注予定（工事・委託・物品役務）

area.description: Prefecture. Accepts 福岡県, 福岡, Fukuoka, 40 (JIS code), national (国の機関)

buyer.description: Procuring entity: name (part of it is fine) or a buyer_id from resolve_names / get_buyer_profile

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous result, with the same other arguments. Up to 3 pages.

fiscal_year.description: Japanese fiscal year (April to March), e.g. 2026 = 2026-04 to 2027-03

include_announced.description: true: also return plans whose tender notice has already been published (with a link to it). Default false.

keyword.description: Words in the title, buyer, department, work type or place. Space = AND. Example: 舗装 修繕

kind.description: 工事 = construction works, 委託 = consulting/survey/design and other outsourcing, 物品役務 = goods and services

quarter.description: Quarter of the fiscal year: 1 = Apr-Jun, 2 = Jul-Sep, 3 = Oct-Dec, 4 = Jan-Mar. Without fiscal_year and quarter, plans from the current quarter on are returned (and those with no period given).

response_format.description: concise (default): fewer fields per row. detailed: adds IDs, method, original URL and retrieval date per row.

name: search_bid_plans

access.description: Whether this result is shown in full through this server: public = yes; not_public_now = the item exists but this server does not return it at present (e.g. a notice whose deadline has passed); login_required / plan_required = the item exists but is available only under other access conditions of the site (sign-in, or a plan)

cite_as.description: One-line source citation for this result: the page title on 入札案件観測所, the data date, and the URL of that page (same as `url`).

try_keyword.description: A different wording of the keyword (synonym) and how many records it matches; call again with keyword set to this

related.description: Facts related to this result (counts) and the tool call that returns them

restricted.description: Items that exist but are not returned here, with their access value. An item listed here is not missing from the data.

when.description: Planned period as published: fiscal year and quarter (Japanese fiscal year starts in April), with the month when the buyer gave one

title: 入札予定（発注の見通し）を探す
